description.value: Green Leaf Sushi is a Japanese-focused restaurant chain with four Lower Mainland locations; the North Vancouver branch is situated in the Lonsdale neighbourhood. The menu spans what the restaurant describes as traditional favourites and innovative creations. Indoor seating is available and phone-in takeout orders are accepted.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website's North Vancouver/Lonsdale location listing (117 W 1st St, N. Vancouver; (604) 968-1171). The website confirms the business is open and operating across four Lower Mainland locations, with the North Vancouver page confirming phone-in takeout ordering. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Green Leaf Sushi Cafe' but the website consistently uses 'Green Leaf Sushi' or 'Green Leaf Restaurant' — no 'Cafe' suffix appears anywhere on the site.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were derived from the website's North Vancouver/Lonsdale location listing and are not independently verifiable against OSM data.
OSM cuisine tags list japanese;korean;italian;french, which is unusually broad for a sushi restaurant and is not corroborated by any menu or description on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate operating restaurant in the Lonsdale area of North Vancouver, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed, making it difficult to assess WWC accreditation fit without an on-the-ground check.
enrichment_extras.notes: Address and phone used in this record are taken from the website's North Vancouver/Lonsdale location section (117 W 1st St, N. Vancouver; (604) 968-1171), as OSM carries no contact details for this node.
